future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Leverage existing signal decomposition techniques with added physical modeling layers using Python-based scientific computing tools

future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Build on existing adversarial disentanglement frameworks with added hardware metadata processing modules

future_contributions.expected_impact: Enhance identification accuracy in mixed signal environments while maintaining computational efficiency for real-time applications
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Implement with existing signal processing libraries and reinforcement learning frameworks
